# IntelliJ Plugin

> The MongoDB for IntelliJ Plugin is a tool designed to improve the development experience for Java developers working with IntelliJ IDEA.

- [Autocomplete](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-intellij/autocomplete.md): Use the MongoDB for IntelliJ Plugin to autocomplete database, collection, and document field names.
- [Connect to Your MongoDB Deployment](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-intellij/connect.md): Connect to your MongoDB deployment with the MongoDB for IntelliJ Plugin.
- [Database Reference Validation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-intellij/db-reference-validation.md): Use the MongoDB for IntelliJ Plugin to verify that specified databases, collections, and document fields exist in your data source.
- [Disable Warnings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-intellij/disable-warnings.md)
- [Index Performance Warnings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-intellij/index-warning.md): The MongoDB for IntelliJ Plugin examines Java code for missing indexes.
- [MongoDB for IntelliJ Plugin](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-intellij/index.md): The MongoDB for IntelliJ Plugin is a tool designed to improve the development experience for Java developers working with IntelliJ IDEA.
- [Install the MongoDB for IntelliJ Plugin](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-intellij/install.md): Install the MongoDB for IntelliJ Plugin from the JetBrains Marketplace.
- [Java Driver Methods to Generate Insights](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-intellij/java-driver-methods-introspection.md): Java driver methods that support generated insights by the IntelliJ Plugin.
- [Retrieve IntelliJ Logs](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-intellij/logs.md): Retrieve log files from IntelliJ IDEA to diagnose bugs and submit feedback.
- [Run Java Queries](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-intellij/run-java-queries.md): Use the MongoDB for IntelliJ Plugin to run Java queries in the Database Explorer Playgrounds.
- [Spring Criteria Methods to Generate Insights](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-intellij/spring-criteria-methods-introspection.md): Spring Criteria methods that support generated insights by the IntelliJ Plugin.
- [Submit Feedback](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-intellij/submit-feedback.md): Submit feedback on the MongoDB for IntelliJ Plugin JIRA project.
- [Type Validation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-intellij/type-validation.md): The MongoDB for IntelliJ Plugin examines Java code for invalid types.
